text:
maya (PM): Quick check-in  BankCo wants tenant-held keys + a 5-year audit lane for only audit_logs + evidence. They also want an emergency retention-extension path. Can we pilot?

leo (security): We can for pilot but require: KMS attestation docs, signed export manifests (sha256), and legal_hold override semantics. No GA BYOK until legal signs off. :lock:

tess (eng-infra): Tech approach: add 3 tiers (90d / 1y / 5y) stored as cold objects; keep a small metadata index for export lookups only. Full-text search on 5y will be export-first. API sketch: PATCH /v1/tenants/:id/retention {"tier":"archival","scopes":["audit_logs","evidence"]} (pilot: support-only).

omar (ops): Escape hatch idea: support ticket with two approvals (SRE + customer admin signature), temp extension <=30d, auto-revert scheduled, and approval hash stored in audit log. Ops will require a runbook step: verify-keystore-ownership before any export.

nina (sales): BankCo prefers Console toggle but will accept a pilot if we provide procurement one-pager and a capped 12-month archival spend option. They expect proof-of-export and SLA.

provision-bot: onboarding job queued: tenant BankCo (BYOK)  job #9997 pending manual review.

maya (PM): Proposed pilot MVP: manual BYOK onboarding, support-only retention toggle up to 30d, export bundle with signed manifest + sha256 checksums, onboarding fee + per-GB archival billing, optional 12-month cap as contract. Launch gates: attestation checklist, legal OK, ops runbook, cost estimate.

leo (security): Also require export SLO: pilot = 48h, GA target = 12h. Include customer signature when delivering bundle.

tess (eng-infra): Risk: indexing/archive costs. I'll provide a storage + cost estimate and a stub CLI for export by EOW. Example CLI:
```
redwood export --tenant TBC --scope evidence --from 2021-01-01 --to 2026-01-01 --out bankco-evidence.tar.gz
```

omar (ops): Action: draft runbook skeleton w/ verify-keystore-ownership, capture approval hash, run export, validate checksums, deliver bundle, and on-call steps. Due Wed.

nina (sales): I'll draft the one-pager after PM posts manifest template.

maya (PM): Timeline: Q2 pilot (support-only), Q3 self-serve + billing integration if gates met. Assigning: tess -> cost estimate; leo -> attestation checklist; omar -> runbook; nina -> one-pager.

provision-bot: job #9997 manual review approved by omar  status: staging-approved.

maya (PM): Thanks everyone. Closing thread, will open feature ticket with MVP spec. :white_check_mark:
